items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Maybe that explains why he's a Republican. He's the only jazz musicians that's ever campaigned for Nixon and Ford or those people. [INTERVIEWEE] He's Rockefeller's man.

ctx.x: They never paid me for arrangements, Mingus Fingers or nothing.
Maybe that explains why he's a Republican. He's the only jazz musicians that's ever campaigned for Nixon and Ford or those people.
